.create table MaritimeAIS (
    IngestionTime: datetime,
    MMSI: long,
    ShipName: string,
    VesselType: int,
    Latitude: real,
    Longitude: real,
    SpeedKnots: real,
    HeadingDegrees: real,
    TransmittedUtc: datetime
)

LatestShipPositions
| take 1

.create-or-alter materialized-view LatestShipPositions on table maritimeAIS {
    maritimeAIS
    | extend CurrentLocation = pack("type", "Point", "coordinates", pack_array(Longitude, Latitude))
    | summarize arg_max(IngestionTime, *) by MMSI
}


.create-or-alter table MaritimeAIS ingestion json mapping "AISMapping"
'['
    '{"column":"IngestionTime", "Properties":{"Path":"$.IngestionTime"}},'
    '{"column":"MMSI", "Properties":{"Path":"$.MMSI"}},'
    '{"column":"ShipName", "Properties":{"Path":"$.ShipName"}},'
    '{"column":"VesselType", "Properties":{"Path":"$.VesselType"}},'
    '{"column":"Latitude", "Properties":{"Path":"$.Latitude"}},'
    '{"column":"Longitude", "Properties":{"Path":"$.Longitude"}},'
    '{"column":"SpeedKnots", "Properties":{"Path":"$.SpeedKnots"}},'
    '{"column":"HeadingDegrees", "Properties":{"Path":"$.HeadingDegrees"}},'
    '{"column":"TransmittedUtc", "Properties":{"Path":"$.TransmittedUtc"}}'
']'


maritimeAIS | summarize arg_max(TransmittedUtc, *) 
by MMSI | project MMSI, ShipName, VesselType

maritimezones_internal | getschema

.create-merge table maritimeAIS_Enriched (
    MMSI: int,
    ShipName: string,
    VesselType: string,
    Latitude: real, 
    Longitude: real, 
    SpeedKnots:real,
    HeadingDegrees: real,
    TransmittedUtc: string , 
    IsInZone: bool, 
    ZoneID: string, 
    ZoneName: string, 
    RiskLevel: string, 
    PremiumMultiplier: real,
    EnrichedIngestionTime: datetime // <-- Add this
)

.create table maritimezones_internal (
    ZoneID: string,
    ZoneName: string,
    RiskLevel: string,
    PremiumMultiplier: real,
    ZonePolygonGeoJSON: dynamic
)

.set-or-append maritimezones_internal <| 
    external_table("maritimezones")
    | project 
        ZoneID, 
        ZoneName, 
        RiskLevel, 
        PremiumMultiplier = toreal(PremiumMultiplier),      // Convert decimal to real
        ZonePolygonGeoJSON = todynamic(ZonePolygonGeoJSON)  // Convert string to dynamic

.create-or-alter function EnrichMaritimeAIS() {
    maritimeAIS
    // 1. Cross join with the static zones table using a dummy key
    | extend dummy = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        maritimezones_internal 
        | extend dummy = 1
    ) on dummy
    // 2. Evaluate if the point sits inside this specific record's polygon
    | extend IsInThisZone = geo_point_in_polygon(Longitude, Latitude, todynamic(ZonePolygonGeoJSON))
    // 3. Summarize to find the true matching zone per original coordinate
    | summarize 
        IsInZone = anyif(IsInThisZone, IsInThisZone == true),
        // Pick the attributes of the matching zone, otherwise leave null
        ZoneID = anyif(ZoneID, IsInThisZone == true),
        ZoneName = anyif(ZoneName, IsInThisZone == true),
        RiskLevel = anyif(RiskLevel, IsInThisZone == true),
        PremiumMultiplier = anyif(PremiumMultiplier, IsInThisZone == true)
        by MMSI, ShipName, VesselType, Latitude, Longitude, SpeedKnots, HeadingDegrees, TransmittedUtc
    // 4. Default the boolean flag cleanly if it didn't hit any zones
    | extend IsInZone = iff(isempty(IsInZone), false, IsInZone)
    | project MMSI, ShipName, VesselType, Latitude, Longitude, SpeedKnots, HeadingDegrees, TransmittedUtc, IsInZone, ZoneID, ZoneName, RiskLevel,
     PremiumMultiplier , EnrichedIngestionTime=now()
}


.create-or-alter function EnrichMaritimeAIS() {
    // 1. Centralized Zone Definitions (Your internal "lookup" dictionary)
    let IranZoneId = "RedZone";
    let IranZoneName = "Iran High Risk Zone - Strait of Hormuz";
    let IranRisk = "Critical";
    let IranMultiplier = toreal(5.5);
    let IranGeo = todynamic('{"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[[[55.8,26.65],[56.25,26.75],[56.6,26.55],[56.85,26.3],[56.65,26.15],[56.1,26.35],[55.8,26.65]]]}');
    //
    let Zone2Id = "YellowZone";
    let Zone2Name = "Western Transit Corridor";
    let Zone2Risk = "Medium";
    let Zone2Multiplier = toreal(1.2);
    let westCorridorGeo = todynamic('{"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[[[54.8,26.55],[55.3,26.45],[55.7,26.35],[55.75,26.15],[55.4,25.95],[54.9,25.85],[54.5,25.95],[54.45,26.3],[54.8, 26.55]]]}');
    //
    // 2. Stream Processing Pipeline
    maritimeAIS
    | extend 
        HitIran = geo_point_in_polygon(Longitude, Latitude, IranGeo),
        HitZone2 = geo_point_in_polygon(Longitude, Latitude, westCorridorGeo)
    | extend 
        IsInZone = (HitIran or HitZone2),
        ZoneID = case(HitIran, IranZoneId, HitZone2, Zone2Id, ""),
        ZoneName = case(HitIran, IranZoneName, HitZone2, Zone2Name, ""),
        RiskLevel = case(HitIran, IranRisk, HitZone2, Zone2Risk, ""),
        PremiumMultiplier = case(HitIran, IranMultiplier, HitZone2, Zone2Multiplier, toreal(1))
    | project 
        MMSI, 
        ShipName, 
        VesselType, 
        Latitude, 
        Longitude, 
        SpeedKnots, 
        HeadingDegrees, 
        TransmittedUtc,
        IsInZone,                    
        ZoneID,                      
        ZoneName,                    
        RiskLevel,                   
        PremiumMultiplier, 
        EnrichedIngestionTime = now()
}




.alter table maritimeAIS_Enriched policy update @'[{"IsEnabled": true, "Source": "maritimeAIS", "Query": "EnrichMaritimeAIS()", "IsTransactional": false, "PropagateIngestionProperties": false}]'



.create-or-alter function with (skipvalidation = "true") GetLiveShipPositionsWithZones() {
    // 1. Call your existing function and immediately inject the join key
    GetLiveShipPositions()
    | extend DummyJoinKey = 1
    // 2. Cross-join lookup against your Lakehouse shortcut zones table
    | lookup kind=leftouter (
        maritimezones 
        | extend DummyJoinKey = 1
    ) on DummyJoinKey
    // 3. Compute the geospatial intersection math using the stringified JSON shape
    | extend IsInside = geo_point_in_polygon(
        todouble(Longitude), 
        todouble(Latitude), 
        parse_json(ZonePolygonGeoJSON)
    )
    // 4. Clean up the placeholder join key and output the final schema
    | project-away DummyJoinKey
    | project IngestionTime, MMSI, ShipName, SpeedKnots, Latitude, Longitude, 
              IsInside, ZoneID, ZoneName, RiskLevel, PremiumMultiplier
}


maritimeAIS_Enriched | where ShipName == "SIMULATED_TANKER_01" and IsInZone == true

.show materialized-view ['LatestShipPositions']

.create-or-alter materialized-view LatestShipPositionsEnriched on table maritimeAIS_Enriched {
    maritimeAIS_Enriched
    | extend CurrentLocation = pack("type", "Point", "coordinates", pack_array(Longitude, Latitude))
    | summarize arg_max(EnrichedIngestionTime, *) by MMSI
}

maritimeAIS_Enriched
| where IsInZone == true

maritimeAIS_Enriched
    | extend CurrentLocation = pack("type", "Point", "coordinates", pack_array(Longitude, Latitude))
    | summarize arg_max(EnrichedIngestionTime, *) by MMSI

LatestShipPositionsEnriched | where IsInZone == true

.show materialized-view ['LatestShipPositionsEnriched'] details
